name: Tandoori Paneer Tikka
ingredients: 200 g low-fat paneer, cut in large cubes
1 capsicum and 1 onion, cut in squares
1 tsp tikka masala or ½ tsp each chilli powder, coriander powder and garam masala
¼ tsp turmeric and ½ tsp ajwain
steps: Whisk the yogurt with the ginger-garlic paste, spices, oil, lemon and salt. Add the paneer and vegetables and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers, alternating paneer, capsicum and onion.
Roast at 220°C for 15–18 minutes, turning once, until the edges char lightly.
Sprinkle with chaat masala and a squeeze of lemon. Serve with mint chutney.
note: Oven-roasted rather than fried or basted with butter. Use thick, strained yogurt so the marinade clings.
